about_the_game:
The soundtrack for the yuri coming-of-age adventure game, "Black Lily's Tale", brought to you in collaboration by Fukahire and 1000-REKA.

This album includes the in-game background music, as well as the opening song, "Transparent Bud", and the ending song, "A Small Sign"!

The soundtrack is brought to you by ZIZZ STUDIO, an esteemed studio that has produced music for all kinds of games!

Miss Minato Izuki provides beautiful vocals for the opening and ending songs!

Every involved artist has crafted an album that brings color into the emotional world of Black Lily's Tale!

The contents of this soundtrack are in WAV format.
